20261118-physics-g11.material: [H2 Panaliten Fisika] Masalah ngetrapake prinsip Gaya, Gerak, lan Relativitas. Ing lumah rata tanpa gesekan, gaya $F = 10\text{ N}$ tumindak ing benda kanthi massa $m = 2\text{ kg}$ kanthi jarak $4\text{ m}$. Pratelan endi sing bener nerangake gaweyan $W$ lan percepatan $a$?
20261118-physics-g11.s.s1.prompt: [H2 Panaliten Fisika] Masalah ngetrapake prinsip Gaya, Gerak, lan Relativitas. Ing lumah rata tanpa gesekan, gaya $F = 10\text{ N}$ tumindak ing benda kanthi massa $m = 2\text{ kg}$ kanthi jarak $4\text{ m}$. Pratelan endi sing bener nerangake gaweyan $W$ lan percepatan $a$?
20261118-physics-g11.s.s1.explain:
Langkah 1: Saka hukum Newton II $F = ma$, percepatan $a = \frac{F}{m} = \frac{10\text{ N}}{2\text{ kg}} = 5\text{ m/s}^2$.
Langkah 2: Gaweyan yaiku $W = F \cdot s = 10\text{ N} \times 4\text{ m} = 40\text{ J}$.
Langkah 3: Mula percepatan yaiku $5\text{ m/s}^2$ lan gaweyan $40\text{ J}$.
20261118-physics-g11.s.s1.hint.0: Hukum Newton II: gunakake rumus $F = ma$.
20261118-physics-g11.s.s1.hint.1: Definisi gaweyan: gunakake rumus $W = F \times s$.

20261121-physics-g11-1.title: Gaya, Gerak, lan Relativitas
20261121-physics-g11-1.goal: Trapake prinsip Gaya, Gerak, lan Relativitas kanggo ngrampungake masalah panaliten.
20261121-physics-g11-1.material: [H2 Panaliten Fisika (Lanjutan)] Analisis obah tibo bebas gegandhengan karo Gaya, Gerak, lan Relativitas. Benda ditibakake saka kahanan meneng ing vakum ing gravitasi $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Pira kacepatan $v$ lan jarak tibo $h$ sawise $t = 3\text{ s}$?
20261121-physics-g11-1.s.s1.prompt: [H2 Panaliten Fisika (Lanjutan)] Analisis obah tibo bebas gegandhengan karo Gaya, Gerak, lan Relativitas. Benda ditibakake saka kahanan meneng ing vakum ing gravitasi $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Pira kacepatan $v$ lan jarak tibo $h$ sawise $t = 3\text{ s}$?
20261121-physics-g11-1.s.s1.explain:
Langkah 1: Kacepatan $v = gt = 9.8 \times 3 = 29.4\text{ m/s}$.
Langkah 2: Jarak $h = \frac{1}{2}gt^2 = 0.5 \times 9.8 \times 9 = 44.1\text{ m}$.
Langkah 3: Dadi $v = 29.4\text{ m/s}$ lan $h = 44.1\text{ m}$.

20261121-physics-g12-2.steps.0.explain:
Langkah 1: Kacepatan $v = gt = 9.8 \times 3 = 29.4\text{ m/s}$.
Langkah 2: Jarak $h = \frac{1}{2}gt^2 = 0.5 \times 9.8 \times 9 = 44.1\text{ m}$.
Langkah 3: Dadi $v = 29.4\text{ m/s}$ lan $h = 44.1\text{ m}$.

20261122-physics-g12-1.title: Fisika Modern lan Medan Elektromagnet
20261122-physics-g12-1.goal: Trapake prinsip Fisika Modern lan Medan Elektromagnet kanggo ngrampungake masalah panaliten.
20261122-physics-g12-1.material: [H3 Panaliten Fisika] Masalah ngetrapake prinsip Fisika Modern lan Medan Elektromagnet. Ing lumah rata tanpa gesekan, gaya $F = 10\text{ N}$ tumindak ing benda kanthi massa $m = 2\text{ kg}$ kanthi jarak $4\text{ m}$. Pratelan endi sing bener nerangake gaweyan $W$ lan percepatan $a$?
20261122-physics-g12-1.s.s1.prompt: [H3 Panaliten Fisika] Masalah ngetrapake prinsip Fisika Modern lan Medan Elektromagnet. Ing lumah rata tanpa gesekan, gaya $F = 10\text{ N}$ tumindak ing benda kanthi massa $m = 2\text{ kg}$ kanthi jarak $4\text{ m}$. Pratelan endi sing bener nerangake gaweyan $W$ lan percepatan $a$?
20261122-physics-g12-1.s.s1.explain:
Langkah 1: Saka hukum Newton II $F = ma$, percepatan $a = \frac{F}{m} = \frac{10\text{ N}}{2\text{ kg}} = 5\text{ m/s}^2$.
Langkah 2: Gaweyan yaiku $W = F \cdot s = 10\text{ N} \times 4\text{ m} = 40\text{ J}$.
Langkah 3: Mula percepatan yaiku $5\text{ m/s}^2$ lan gaweyan $40\text{ J}$.
20261122-physics-g12-1.s.s1.hint.0: Hukum Newton II: gunakake rumus $F = ma$.
20261122-physics-g12-1.s.s1.hint.1: Definisi gaweyan: gunakake rumus $W = F \times s$.
